scope: task-specific projection/event dependency qualification; full-model cross-replay numerical equivalence not established
calibration: native-off serial A only; independent complete projection repeats plus 32 dense and 32 sparse restored-cache repeats across eight ranks
definition: RMS(actual-serial_reference)/RMS(serial_reference); max(abs(actual-serial_reference))/RMS(serial_reference). Zero reference RMS requires zero difference. Both outputs must be finite.
downstream: identical raw candidate Q/K fed to serial-shadow consumers after executing and retaining original serial projections; all remaining comparisons exact until separately reviewed
cross_replay: Retain differing final logits, main-attention/layer outputs, and expected-state projections as observations; do not pass a numerical equivalence gate. Require finite complete served outputs.
